request: Can you go through the rest of the comments on my ethics paper and suggest fixes like you did on Monday? Put whatever is left into my checklist too. The final draft is due Friday.
final_message:
I reviewed all eight comments and saved the seven remaining items in your checklist. Monday’s comma fix is already in the dam paragraph. I added one new suggestion for the run-on in paragraph 3. Monday’s citation suggestion is still pending. Check that page 351 in your edition of Parfit supports your claim before accepting it.

Dr. Lindqvist’s Wednesday update limits AI suggestions to wording and grammar, so the checklist uses questions to guide your argument revisions. Start with your reply to Parfit: if no particular person is worse off, why do you think we still owe future people a duty? The checklist also covers your opening thesis, the “most philosophers” claim, what the dam builders knew, and how to compare present and future climate costs.

The final is due Friday, March 12 at 11:59 p.m. Eastern.
